Classic pop-rock favorites burst to life, woven with intimate, cabaret-style moments where performers share funny, heartfelt stories about love — the kind that will have you laughing one minute and leaning a little closer to the person beside you the next. events.title: Play with a Play
events.description: An exclusive subscriber and donor experience! Before its 2028 world premiere at Prima, Play With A Play offers a rare chance to hear the not-yet-announced next new play early – not at its final arrival, but at the living, breathing beginning. Professional actors give the work its first life aloud, creating an experience that places you unusually close to the creative spark. The evening then opens into live conversation with both author and performers, exploring what is stirring in the piece, what is resonating in the room, and what it means to meet a story this early in its life. This is more than attending an intimate, ground-level reading of a play. It is a front-row seat to the creative process itself as new work takes its first breath, and to take part in the dialogue that helps shape what it becomes. For Prima subscribers, Play with a Play serves as your fifth experience this season. Also open to Prima sponsors and Producer’s Circle donors. events.title: Stephen Schwartz: A Benefit Concert for Prima
events.description: Get Tickets 📍 Rock Lititz - 100 Rock Lititz Blvd, Lititz, PA Broadway legend Stephen Schwartz — the Grammy, Oscar, and Tony Award–winning composer of Wicked, Pippin, Godspell, Pocahontas, The Hunchback of Notre Dame, The Prince of Egypt, and Enchanted — comes to Lancaster County for a once-in-a-lifetime benefit event at Rock Lititz. At the piano, Schwartz will perform his most beloved works and share stories from a career that has shaped Broadway and Disney alike. He is joined by powerhouse Prima performers, filling the space with music, heart, and meaning. But this evening is about more than a concert. It’s a moment to fuel the next great cultural movement in Lancaster. Just as Rock Lititz redefined what’s possible in live music, Prima is redefining what’s possible in live theatre — making Lancaster the launchpad for bold, original works that premiere locally before reaching national stages. Your participation helps fuel cultural vitality, community vibrancy, and economic growth for our region. WHY THIS NIGHT MATTERS Rock Lititz showed that the world’s biggest tours can start here. Prima is proving that tomorrow’s great theatrical works can, too. This benefit event fuels Prima’s mission to invigorate lives through fresh theatrical experiences — performances that are intimate, joyful, and deeply human. Your support helps: Launch bold new theatrical works born in Lancaster. Bring national artists and creative voices to our community. Give audiences world-class experiences first, right here at home. This night ensures Lancaster isn’t just consuming culture — it’s creating it. events.title: We’ll Get Back to You
events.description: A job interview gone-so-wrong-it’s-right play The East Coast Premiere By Rob Bell, one of Time Magazine's Top 100 Most Influential People In The World Viva's corporate job interview is everything except for typical. She defies all conventional norms with a captivating blend of authenticity, humor, and heart. With unwavering honesty and vitality, Viva offers a mesmerizing glimpse into the transformative power of embracing our humanity to its fullest. We'll Get Back To You marks Prima's first non-musical play, a highly anticipated East Coast premiere brought to life with the exclusive permission and collaboration of its acclaimed culture-shaking author, Rob Bell. Bell's creative prowess has garnered international recognition as a New York Times best-selling author with 10 books translated into 25 languages. From features in The New Yorker to touring alongside Oprah Winfrey, and even earning a spot on Time Magazine's prestigious list of the 100 Most Influential People in the World, Bell's work sets the stage for an unforgettable theatrical experience.
